description: This file is a Python script that initializes a live audio pipeline using the LiveKit service, integrates a text-to-speech service (CartesiaTTS), and sets up event handling for participant interactions within an asynchronous main function.

classes.name: LiveKitTransport
classes.description: Transport class for integrating with LiveKit for real-time audio communication.

classes.name: CartesiaTTSService
classes.description: Service class for text-to-speech using the Cartesia platform.

classes.name: Pipeline
classes.description: Represents a sequence of processing steps within the audio pipeline.

classes.name: PipelineRunner
classes.description: Manages execution of pipeline tasks asynchronously.

classes.name: PipelineTask
classes.description: A task encapsulating a sequence of frames or actions within the pipeline.

classes.name: TTSSpeakFrame
classes.description: A frame representing a spoken message generated by TTS.

methods.name: main()
methods.description: Asynchronous main function initializing the pipeline, configuring services, and setting up event handlers.
